title: Revisiting CUR Perturbation Analysis: A Local Tangent-Space Expansion
summary: CUR decompositions approximate a matrix using selected columns, rows, and their intersection. Classical CUR theory provides exactness results for low-rank matrices and perturbation bounds controlled by the size of the noise. In this work we develop a local perturbation expansion for a fixed-index rank-truncated CUR map near an admissible rank-\(r\) matrix. We show that the Fréchet derivative of the rank-truncated CUR map is a sampling-induced oblique tangent-space projector determined by the selected rows and columns.
